latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of IBM ACE Copilot.

- Provides expert guidance for IBM App Connect Enterprise (ACE) 12.0 development.
- Supports message flow design, ESQL scripting, BAR file deployment, and integration node/server management.
- Helps troubleshoot, debug, and follow best practices for ACE projects.
- Activated when users mention key ACE tasks, commands, or development scenarios.
- Assists with implementing JIRA development workflows within ACE environments.
